proposals.name: De-escalation
proposals.accepted: Both players withdraw. Accepting player: +1 Card.

proposals.name: Orderly Withdrawal
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must be the attacker.
proposals.accepted: The Diplomat withdraws. Accepting player: +1 Card.

proposals.name: Capitulation
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must be the defender.
proposals.accepted: The Diplomat withdraws. Accepting player: +1 Card.

proposals.name: Open Channels
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must have a card in Hand.
proposals.accepted: Both players reveal their Hands, then both withdraw. Accepting player: +1 Card.
proposals.refused: Refusing player reveals their Hand. Diplomat: +1 Reserve.

proposals.name: Mutual Disarmament
proposals.requirement: Both players must have a card in Hand.
proposals.accepted: Each player discards 1 from Hand. Accepting player: +1 Card. Then both withdraw.
proposals.refused: Diplomat may discard 1 from Hand. If they do: +1 Reserve.

proposals.name: Prisoner Exchange
proposals.requirement: Each player must have a card in their Graveyard.
proposals.accepted: Each player may move 1 card from their Graveyard to their Discard Pile. Then both withdraw.
proposals.refused: If the Diplomat loses, they may move 1 card from their Graveyard to their Discard Pile.

proposals.name: Rebuilding Pact
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must have a card in Hand that can be banked as an Asset.
proposals.accepted: Each player may bank 1 Asset from Hand. Then both withdraw.
proposals.refused: In the Aftermath, the Diplomat may bank 1 Asset from Hand.

proposals.name: Diplomatic Recognition
proposals.requirement: The Diplomat must be defending a Counterattack.
proposals.accepted: Diplomat: Advance Front Line 1, if able. Accepting player withdraws, then +2 Cards.
proposals.refused: If the Diplomat wins: Advance Front Line 1 during the Aftermath, if able. No Influence for imposing this Proposal.
